fuel_hazard.description: Represents the relative potential for wildfire spread and intensity based on surface-fuel and canopy-fuel conditions.
fuel_hazard.expected_input_type: Categorical and continuous LANDFIRE fuel rasters

fuel_dryness.description: Represents relative vegetation dryness and fuel condition using remotely sensed vegetation and moisture indicators.
fuel_dryness.expected_input_type: Continuous NDVI, NDMI, or related vegetation-condition rasters

slope_hazard.description: Represents the potential for faster uphill fire spread across increasingly steep terrain.

aspect_hazard.description: Represents terrain-orientation effects on solar exposure, vegetation moisture, and relative surface dryness.
aspect_hazard.normalization_direction: Warmer and drier exposures indicate greater hazard

historical_fire_likelihood.description: Represents relative historical wildfire occurrence based on historical fire occurrence, ignition density, burn frequency, or comparable historical patterns.
historical_fire_likelihood.expected_input_type: Historical ignition points, burn frequency, or fire-likelihood raster
historical_fire_likelihood.normalization_direction: Greater historical occurrence density indicates greater hazard

human_ignition_potential.description: Represents relative opportunity for human-caused ignition near roads, development, access corridors, or related infrastructure.
human_ignition_potential.expected_input_type: Distance, density, or proximity surfaces derived from roads and development
human_ignition_potential.normalization_direction: Greater human ignition opportunity indicates greater hazard
